newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office cancels plans to buy four cos.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office cancels plans to buy four cos.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Thursday that it has decided not to proceed with a purchase of four janitorial supply companies because of various purchase price, integration and product mix concerns.
The company had announced its intention to buy the four companies, its first in the janitorial supply sector, in June, said Chief Financial Officer Donald Platt.
The decision will have no impact on current quarter or future earnings prospects, the company said.
U.S. Products said it will continue evaluating opportunities in the janitorial supply sector.
